label: early input t/z/g/y (pos 2-3) after v or m
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at positions 2-3 (99% of mass); never at t=0,1, nearly never at t>=4, never in the copy phase, and only weakly at <DEL> for L=3. The input token is mostly t (43% of mass), z (26%), g (18%) or y (8%), almost always on its first occurrence. Magnitude depends on the earlier prefix: v and m among the first tokens (prev2=v, prev=m; the top examples look like v m [t] or v v [t]) give the strongest activations, and 1, d, h, i add weaker boosts. Token at positions 2-3 alone: recall 0.91 but precision 0.12. Adding v/m earlier in the prefix: dev P 0.43, R 0.53, F1 0.47, mass recall 0.71. The leftover activity looks like a graded mix of token weights rather than a clean rule.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=3 (+6.87), prev_tok=m (+4.49), prev2_tok=v (+4.10), phase=0 & in_tok=t (+3.82), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=t (+3.82), prev_tok=v (+3.58). Lower it: prev_tok=y (-3.22), prev_tok=g (-3.20), prev2_tok=0 (-3.06), prev2_tok=y (-2.77).
